Atque hæ quidem actiones si iudicio nostro
aut viribus à nobis instituendæ essent, pessimè
sanè nobiscum ageretur: cùm neque certa ea-
rum rudimenta informata in nostris mentibus
habeamus, neque facultatem vel ea ipsa præ-
standi quæ nos docet lux naturalis conscientiæ.
Quamobrem tertium illud in hac sanctissima
communione nobis erat pernecessarium:
nempe ut principium certum, ac immutabile, & ty-
pum operum nostrorum Dominus exhiberet;
Principium, ut viribus illius ageremur: typum,
ut ad exemplum imitationemque illius agere-
mus. Utrumque, in Ecclesia nobis iniùs & fo-
ris suppeditauit Deus, cùm & formam illam
internam, quam Psalmo antecedente diceba-
mus, indidit Ecclesiæ suæ; & formam externam
verbi scripti atque prædicati, iustumque ordi-
nem, qui ad constitutionem Ecclesiæ opus est,

page.notes: The scan shows "fanctiffima" in the printed text; I read it as sanctissima only where the letters were clear. Doubtful readings: "Christiano-rum" (the line-end word is hard to see; marked [?]); "motum" (possible tilde over the u); "iniùs" (grave accent on u as printed); "vehemétia" and "quadám" carry accents as printed. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot, with the catchword "com-" at the lower right. The "&" characters are written as & to keep the XML valid. The faint number in the far-right margin is a stray mark, not printed text, and has been left out.
